notes: The Cognition.X companion to the SmartCiti.X New Orleans Trades Edition (the Crescent Works campus and its walkable city layer). Five tracks of port, ground, water, power and pathway — the trades as New Orleans actually works them. Control-discipline themes mirror the SmartCiti.X simulator rubrics (crane swing management, the trench's flagged utility, ordered procedure), and the honesty stance is shared verbatim: a simulator teaches control discipline and never counts as equipment certification. Facts are public-record Louisiana; transfer checks are phrased against the learner's own parish or home, and every check stays safe — observation from public ground, rated tags and paper trails, never contact with energized, suspended or moving equipment.
